extracted.intended_audience: licensees, applicants, industry stakeholders, regulators, and members of the public interested in NRC proposed rulemakings and notice-and-comment opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: A machine-readable Federal Register API listing of U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission documents of type 'Proposed Rule' with titles, abstracts, URLs, and publication metadata; intended to surface rulemaking actions and opportunities for public comment. The page aggregates many discrete proposed-rule actions (e.g., regulatory amendments, incorporations by reference, fee schedules, spent-fuel cask listings, denials of petitions) from the NRC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Licensing requirements for microreactors and comparable reactors
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend regulations to establish a risk-informed and performance-based regulatory framework for rapid licensing of new microreactors and other reactors with comparable risk profiles and for high-volume deployment of these reactors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would provide a flexible set of licensing pathways, reduce regulatory burden, and ensure that safety and security requirements remain commensurate with the potential hazards posed by these facilities; solicits public comment via the proposed rule docket (html/pdf URLs provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions from foreign ownership, control, or domination (FOCD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend regulations on foreign ownership, control, or domination (FOCD) of utilization facilities to comply with section 301 of the Accelerating Deployment of Versatile, Advanced Nuclear for Clean Energy Act of 2024, which designates certain exceptions from the FOCD provision set forth in the Atomic Energy Act of 1954.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Changes would affect applicants and licensees of utilization facilities owned, controlled, or dominated by a foreign entity; public comment requested on the proposed regulatory amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modernize physical protection requirements for category 1 and 2 radioactive material
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose wholesale revision of regulations relating to physical protection and security of category 1 and category 2 quantities of radioactive material as part of a broader review of NRC regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim is to update physical protection/security rules; the proposal is part of an initiative and seeks public comment on the specific revisions and implementation considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment to List of Approved Spent Fuel Storage Casks — Holtec HI-STORM UMAX (CoC No. 1040, Amendment No. 5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to revise the HI-STORM UMAX Canister Storage System listing within the 'List of approved spent fuel storage casks' to include Amendment No. 5, which revises the certificate of compliance to include two new versions of the HI-STORM UMAX design (Version B1 and B2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proposed revision updates the CoC listing to include new design versions; stakeholders (licensees, manufacturers) and the public can comment on technical and safety implications via the docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leveraging DOE/Department of War prior authorizations for reactor design reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to revise regulations to facilitate direct leveraging of prior U.S. Department of Energy or Department of War authorizations of demonstration reactors into NRC licensing reviews of commercial reactor facility applications that reference those designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would establish an additional regulatory means for applicants to demonstrate safety functions of reactor designs, intended to improve NRC licensing review efficiency where applicable; solicits comment on leveraging prior authorizations and related implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee schedules and fee recovery for Fiscal Year 2026
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend licensing, inspection, special project, and annual fees charged to applicants and licensees to comply with the Nuclear Energy Innovation and Modernization Act, which requires the NRC to recover, to the maximum extent practicable, approximately 100 percent of its annual budget less certain excluded amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also proposes establishing fixed caps on service fees to implement Executive Order 14300, 'Ordering the Reform of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission,' which would drive increased efficiency and accountability in NRC licensing activities; comments invited on fee changes and caps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public meeting notice: streamlining contested adjudications (virtual meeting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice of a virtual-only public meeting to discuss proposed revisions to the agency's rules of practice and procedure to streamline contested adjudications in NRC licensing proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meeting intended to promote public understanding of the proposed revisions and to facilitate public comments; separate docket contains the proposed rule text and opportunity for formal comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed rule: streamlining contested adjudications in licensing proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to revise the agency's rules of practice and procedure to streamline contested adjudications in NRC licensing proceedings in response to the ADVANCE Act and Executive Order 14300.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revisions aim to streamline licensing adjudication processes; NRC seeks comment on the proposed procedural changes and their effects on parties and the licensing timeline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation by reference — ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (2023 Edition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend regulations to incorporate by reference the 2023 Edition of the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code and incorporate proposed revisions of three regulatory guides and the draft version of an additional regulatory guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This action maintains safety and updates standards available as voluntary alternatives for construction, inservice inspection, and testing of nuclear power plant components; NRC requests comments on the proposed rule and draft regulatory guides.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory framework for fusion machines
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend regulations to augment the existing byproduct material framework to be inclusive of fusion machines by proposing technology-inclusive requirements to accommodate a wide variety of anticipated fusion machine designs across the National Materials Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issuing draft implementation guidance (NUREG-1556, Vol. 22) alongside the proposed rule; NRC will conduct public meeting(s) and seeks comments on all aspects of the proposed rule and guidance to facilitate understanding and public input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of rulemaking activities being discontinued by the NRC
rubrics_metrics.description: Inform members of the public that three NRC rulemaking activities are being discontinued and provide a brief discussion of the decision to discontinue them; these will no longer be reported in the NRC's portion of the Unified Agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides rationale and transparency about discontinuation decisions; useful to stakeholders tracking rulemaking priorities and schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment to List of Approved Spent Fuel Storage Casks — TN Americas NUHOMS EOS (CoC No. 1042, Amendment No. 5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to revise the NUHOMS Extended Optimized Storage (EOS) Dry Spent Fuel Storage System listing to include Amendment No. 5, which would add a new heat load zone configuration for the EOS-37PTH canister, increase maximum heat load to 54 kW per dry shielded canister for certain configurations, clarify acceptance criteria for minor surface imperfections, and make editorial and technical updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendment includes technical clarifications (use of MAVRIC software, new loading patterns, material options, crane usage, etc.); NRC requests comment on the changes to technical specifications and safety analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public meeting notice: Incorporation by Reference of IEEE Std 603-2018
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice that the NRC plans to hold a public meeting to discuss the recently published proposed rule to incorporate by reference IEEE Std 603-2018, 'IEEE Standard Criteria for Safety Systems for Nuclear Power Generating Stations,' and the accompanying Draft Regulatory Guide DG-1251, Revision 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public meeting intended to explain the proposal and facilitate comments; meeting complements the public comment docket for the proposed incorporation by reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed rule: incorporation by reference of IEEE Std 603-2018
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend regulations to incorporate by reference IEEE Std 603-2018, addressing power, instrumentation, and control safety systems for nuclear power reactors, including editorial changes that do not change the technical information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporation updates the technical standard used by licensees/applicants; NRC plans public outreach and requests comments on the proposed rule and any technical implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of Approved Spent Fuel Storage Casks — NAC International NAC-UMS (CoC No. 1015, Renewed Amendment No. 10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend spent fuel regulations by revising the NAC-UMS design listing to include Renewed Amendment No. 10 and revise Renewed Amendment Nos. 5–9 to correct licensing basis deficiencies and update the applicant's headquarters address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendments correct licensing-basis issues and administrative details; stakeholders may review technical corrections and provide comments via the docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Sunset Rule (conditional sunset dates in regulations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend regulations to insert a conditional sunset date into certain regulations in response to Executive Order 14270, 'Zero-Based Regulatory Budgeting to Unleash American Energy.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This would add conditional expiration dates to selected regulations; NRC solicits comment on which regulations to include and the implications of conditional sunsets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval of ASME unconditioned code cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend regulations to incorporate by reference a regulatory guide that approves unconditioned code cases published by ASME, allowing licensees/applicants to use code cases as voluntary alternatives to engineering standards for nuclear power plant components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Action aligns with existing incorporation by reference of ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code and ASME Operation and Maintenance standards; NRC requests comments on the proposed regulatory guide and the unconditioned code cases it approves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment to List of Approved Spent Fuel Storage Casks — TN Americas NUHOMS EOS (CoC No. 1042, Amendment No. 4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to revise the NUHOMS EOS listing to include Amendment No. 4, which changes the certificate to incorporate a method to determine new loading patterns, introduce a steel plate composite option, introduce use of MAVRIC software for confirmatory dose runs, update technical specs and UFSAR editorial corrections, add measured exposures, allow blended Portland cement, change crane usage, and clarify scenarios for heat load reductions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical and editorial updates intended to improve clarity, correct references, and expand options; comments invited on safety analyses and technical changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Denial of petition: voluntary adoption of revised design-basis accident dose criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: NRC is denying a petition for rulemaking requesting development of a rule to allow voluntary adoption of revised accident dose acceptance criteria for control room, exclusion area boundary, and low population zone outer boundary, and revisions to clarify footnotes discussing these criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Denial rationale: information presented does not support rulemaking and proposed changes are not necessary to provide reasonable assurance of adequate protection of public health and safety; record documents the NRC's analysis and justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Denial of petition: licensing safety analysis for loss-of-coolant accidents
rubrics_metrics.description: NRC is denying a petition for rulemaking that requested amendments regarding licensing safety analysis for loss-of-coolant accidents; NRC is instead addressing emergency core cooling system performance with a risk-informed and performance-based approach rather than the deterministic approach suggested by the petitioner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Denial explains NRC's current regulatory approach and rationale for not pursuing the petitioner’s suggested amendments; provides stakeholders with the agency's reasoning and references to the docket.
